brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates complete and reliable responsibility-chain execution with no serious or minor in-chain errors. All six RC items were met with appropriate risk recognition, danger screening, records verification, urgent action planning, emergency thresholds, and execution/closure handling. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact through source control explanation, false-negative security correction, and dynamic reprioritization. HO2 was partially completed through workspace query and targeted questioning. The closure was valid with teach-back confirmation and specific action plans.
